title: In Photos: A glimpse of birdlife in Cabusao wetlands

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — From great egrets spreading their wings across the sky to collared kingfishers perched along muddy shores, the Cabusao Wetlands Critical Habitat in Camarines Sur is home to various bird species captured in photographs released by the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) Bicol. The photos feature great egrets, Javan pond herons, striated herons, whiskered terns, Philippine pied fantails and collared kingfishers, offering a glimpse of the wetland’s avian diversity. The images were documented as part of DENR Bicol’s communication, education and public awareness campaign in celebration of World Migratory Bird Day.
